27:     if (gameOver) return;

31:     if (keys['ArrowUp'] && ship.y > 0) ship.y -= ship.speed;
32:     if (keys['ArrowDown'] && ship.y + ship.h < height) ship.y += ship.speed;
33: 
34:     // spawn asteroids
35:     if (Math.random() < asteroidSpawnRate) {
36:       const size = 20 + Math.random() * 30;

38:     }
39:     // spawn fuel canisters
40:     if (Math.random() < fuelSpawnRate) {
41:       const s = 20;
42:       fuels.push({ x: Math.random() * (width - s), y: -s, w: s, h: s, speed: 2 });
43:     }
44: 
45:     // move asteroids & fuels
46:     asteroids.forEach(a => a.y += a.speed);
47:     fuels.forEach(f => f.y += f.speed);

50:     fuels = fuels.filter(f => f.y < height);
51: 
52:     // fuel consumption
53:     fuel -= 0.05;
54:     if (fuel <= 0) gameOver = true;
55: 
56:     // collisions
57:     for (const a of asteroids) {
58:       if (rectsIntersect(ship, a)) { gameOver = true; break; }
59:     }

61:       if (rectsIntersect(ship, fuels[i])) {
62:         fuel = Math.min(100, fuel + 30);

64:         score += 10;
65:       }
66:     }

68:     score += 0.1;
69:   }

71:   function rectsIntersect(r1, r2) {
72:     return !(r2.x > r1.x + r1.w ||
73:              r2.x + r2.w < r1.x ||
74:              r2.y > r1.y + r1.h ||
75:              r2.y + r2.h < r1.y);
76:   }
77: 
78:   function draw() {
79:     // clear
80:     ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
81:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
82:     // stars background – simple static dots
83:     ctx.fillStyle = '#444';

102:       ctx.fill();
103:     });
104:     // fuel canisters – green squares
105:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0f0';
106:     fuels.forEach(f => ctx.fillRect(f.x, f.y, f.w, f.h));
107:     // HUD
108:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
109:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
